messages:
Noah B.: Heads-up: new billing/quota update will take effect Aug 12. Main items: staggered soft rate caps per plan, 7-day overage forgiveness for hosted metered customers, trial credits now expire after 90 days (grandfathering for existing credits), and a new invoice webhook for programmatic invoice delivery. Full rollout doc: https://redwood.example.com/internal/billing/aug12 :loudspeaker:
Billing Bot: Doc published: https://redwood.example.com/internal/billing/aug12 (includes CSV schema, webhook payload, and examples)
Ivy C.: Nice. For the invoice webhook, what's the payload? can we get an example so RevOps can hook it into our system?
Noah B.: Example payload is in the doc. Quick sample header: `{"invoice_id":"inv_123","customer_id":"cust_456","period_start":"2026-08-01","period_end":"2026-08-31","total_amount":"1250.00","line_items":[...],"credits_applied":"50.00"}`. Note: our dataset team asked that we also provide a flattened CSV version in the attachment.
Ops: Will per-route quotas be configurable from the Console or only via support? we need to throttle some noisy endpoints per-customer.
Noah B.: Console will expose per-route soft caps for Enterprise and Dedicated customers. Self-serve can set app-level rate padding via API. Support will handle manual adjustments if needed.
Maya R.: For soft caps: do we return 429 immediately or ramp with Retry-After headers? SDK teams need guidance.
Noah B.: We'll send 429s only after a short ramp. Responses will include `X-Redwood-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-Redwood-RateLimit-Remaining`, and `X-Redwood-RateLimit-RetryAfter` when applicable. SDKs should implement exponential backoff plus honoring RetryAfter.
Ivy C.: How are overage charges shown on invoices? single invoice or separate? and will there be a human review during the 7-day grace?
Noah B.: One invoice per month, with distinct line items for overages. During the 7-day grace, we won't bill automatically; we flag the account and send alerts. If overage persists beyond 7 days, charges appear on that month's invoice. RevOps can trigger a manual review during grace if the customer disputes usage.
Legal Bot: Confirming: Dedicated/reserved contracts keep existing terms and are not subject to metered overage forgiveness, correct?
Noah B.: Correct. Dedicated and Reserved agreements remain unchanged. This update targets hosted metered customers.
Ivy C.: Can we get a sample CSV header for scheduled exports? we need it for our ledger import.
Noah B.: CSV header sample in doc: `invoice_id,customer_id,period_start,period_end,total_amount,token_count,overage_amount,credits_applied,webhook_delivered` and a sample row included.
Maya R.: ETA for SDK/header rollout?
Noah B.: SDKs updated by Aug 5. Webhook signing and sample consumer code included. AMA scheduled Aug 3 09:00 PT in #all-hands. Please review the doc and add questions there.
Billing Bot: Reminder: policy effective Aug 12.
